simple.meaning: קִרְיָתַיִם (Qiryâthayim) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Numbers, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, Jeremiah, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 14:5. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִרְיָתַיִם (H7156) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows קִרְיָתַיִם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: קִרְיָתַיִם (Qiryâthayim) / H7156 is tracked through Genesis 14:5, Numbers 32:37, Joshua 13:19, 1 Chronicles 6:61. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

majorEvents.evidenceText: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

timeline.evidenceText: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.
Of Moab. Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says:
on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,
therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
